name: tagline-options
expectations: The response presents between three and five distinct options and names the rhetorical figure used in each
No option uses a negative parallelism ('not just X, it's Y', 'more than just', 'not only X but Y')
Every option is shorter than the input tagline
No option adds a claim absent from the input, such as 'leading', 'the only', 'number one', 'trusted by', or a customer count
The response recommends one option and gives a reason
